name: A lost wallet
prompt: Your wallet isn't in your pocket. The cash in it, your ID and your card were all in there.

outcome.told: You walk back the way you came, asking at every counter.
outcome.line: {you} lost a wallet and found it again.

failure.told: Nobody has seen it. You cancel the card and pay for a new ID.
failure.line: {you} lost a wallet with the cash and the ID in it.

outcome.told: You cancel the card and stand in line for a new ID.
outcome.line: {you} lost a wallet and replaced the ID.
